subject.title: feat(claude): add claude-bridge app-server harness extension

question: Should OpenClaw accept this provider-specific Claude/GLM app-server system as a bundled, foundation-owned runtime surface, or require it to ship as an external plugin with only generic SDK seams proposed separately?
rationale: The branch adds a new managed subprocess, package provenance commitment, auth/session behavior, configuration, and operator UI; choosing their permanent ownership and support boundary cannot be resolved safely by mechanical repair alone.

options.title: Externalize the harness
options.body: Publish the Claude/GLM harness as an external plugin or ClawHub package, retaining only narrowly justified generic SDK seams in core.

options.title: Adopt as bundled runtime
options.body: Accept bundled ownership only after a named owner/security review adopts the bridge package and the PR is reshaped to meet SQLite and plugin-boundary requirements.

options.title: Reject this direction
options.body: Close the bundled proposal and direct users toward the supported existing Anthropic, Claude CLI, or ACP paths.

recommendation.title: Externalize the harness
recommendation.body: Publish the Claude/GLM harness as an external plugin or ClawHub package, retaining only narrowly justified generic SDK seams in core.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked discussion requests a maintainer product decision and identifies prior sponsorship context, though direct ownership evidence is limited.
